title: Creative Systems Toolkit
summary: Small tools for testing brand components, patterns, asset production, and accessibility.
overview: A set of focused utilities for testing brand components, generative patterns, logo placement, asset production, and color contrast. The tools combine observed design-system references with clearly labeled recreated demonstrations and proposed extensions.
coverAlt: Recreated "Button System Lab" interface showing six AppOmni button families with per-state color-contrast ratios

gallery.alt: Recreated "Button System Lab" showing six AppOmni button families (primary, light, dark, and their outline variants) with AA text-contrast ratios for each
Generated token JSON export from the Button System Lab, showing shared geometry values and primary-button state colors each labeled with an "Observed CSS" or "Observed focus rule" provenance
Recreated "Dot Pattern Studio" generative tool showing an editable wave-arranged dot field with spacing, radius, and canvas controls, exported as SVG
The original AppOmni dot pattern as it appears on the live AppOmni Press Releases page, used as the visual reference for the recreated tool
Recreated brand-logo placement tool composing four sample SVG marks (Google, Accenture, Cisco, PwC) from a small supplied logo library into a horizontal row
A WebP asset-export demo showing one sample PNG reduced from 547.6 KB to 60.3 KB, an 89% size reduction on this single image
